apps.name: Bani
apps.subtitle: Log expenses by voice.
apps.localizedDescription: Bani logs your Personal and Work expenses by voice — tap, speak the amount, confirm. On-device Whisper transcription, Romanian + English, no account.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bani uses the microphone to record your voice so you can log expenses by speaking.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 21 — voice pipeline fix: recorded entries are never silently dropped; failed transcriptions stay editable.
